sentence_stem: If I had a lot of money,
correct_completion: I would travel around the world.
full_sentence: If I had a lot of money, I would travel around the world.
acceptable_variants: I would buy a big house.

options.text: I will travel around the world next year.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' is a future form for real plans. A second conditional imagines an unreal situation and needs 'would' in the main clause.

options.text: I would travel around the world.
I travelled around the world yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is a past simple statement about a real event. It does not complete an imagined situation introduced by 'if I had'.

options.text: I have travelled around the world already.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect describes a real experience. It does not fit a hypothetical result after 'if I had'.

grammar_focus: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + base verb
explanation: The second conditional describes an imagined present or future situation. The 'if' clause uses the past simple, and the main clause uses 'would' plus the base verb.
translation: Якби в мене було багато грошей, я б подорожував навколо світу.
